maddeler.e:
يحقوا (form I)
# يَحِقُّوا (yaḥiqqū) /ja.ħiq.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يَحُقُّوا (yaḥuqqū) /ja.ħuq.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يُحَقُّوا (yuḥaqqū) /ju.ħaq.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
